pages.text: Chaos can replace a single-item ingredient with an Auram gear or plate made from that material. The variant stores its material and display name in NBT.$(br2)Use the named material variant shown in JEI. A plain creative-tab gear or plate is not interchangeable with every material variant.

pages.title: Component Recipes
pages.text: Generated gears use four matching material items around an iron nugget in a cross. Plates use eight matching material items around an iron nugget.$(br2)These supporting recipes are exported with the chaos pack when needed. JEI distinguishes component material variants; check the active generated recipe before crafting.
